nodes.label: DEFERRED.md — cross-chapter items deferred during Phase R2 (append-only)
Append-only docket discipline
nodes.rationale: The member is append-only so that no record of a deferral can be erased; later sessions append blocks per chat rather than editing earlier ones. Carried entries from another session are reproduced verbatim, with corrections made only in the framing above them, because rewriting another session's entry would falsify a record.

nodes.label: Closure by citing the READ file, never by deletion
nodes.rationale: An item is closed by a later line that cites the READ file closing it. Deletion would leave no trace that the question was asked, so closure is recorded as an addition.

nodes.label: Do not re-derive; settle each item in the chapter named
nodes.rationale: Each deferred item names the chapter or section that owns it, so that a later reading settles it once in its own place instead of re-deriving the same measurement in every unit that touches it.

The re-anchoring bill — 58 instruments, 612 line literals
nodes.rationale: The volumes were frozen from chat 62 until BUILD92, so the instrument estate was built against fixed line numbers and never had to survive an insertion. Every remaining R3 class that changes volume text will shift them again; the cost is not the repair but the re-anchoring, and whether the estate is re-anchored once or class by class is M's ruling.

nodes.label: Extent is data: score it, never assert it as an invariant
nodes.rationale: The common fault behind three owed successors: an instrument that encodes the Register's extent as an invariant cannot survive a build that seats an entry, which the record does routinely once the hold lifts.

nodes.label: Re-banking a mis-targeted instrument banks its wrong reading as the new truth
nodes.rationale: A green gate over a re-banked mis-read is worse than a red gate, because nothing downstream will ever say the instrument read the wrong site.

nodes.label: A gate run and a build must never overlap
nodes.rationale: Recorded as a process fault: a background gate run had method/members/ rewritten underneath it, and its failures were artefacts of the concurrent mutation.

nodes.label: A regex over source is evidence about the regex until checked against a known instance
nodes.rationale: \b(\d{4,5})\b cannot match L11832 — L is a word character — and L<number> is the form the instruments overwhelmingly use, so the first count came back 46 where the true figure is 58.
